problems: wrong sentence 'starts in six' can be read as correct English (in six minutes)

fix.right: The film starts at six o'clock.
fix.wrong: The film starts in six o'clock.

problems: interleaving partner some/any is not often confused with there is/are; the real confusion is it is vs there is

fix.interleaving: Interleaving partner: it is (it is describes one known thing; there is says something exists); mixed item: Write There is or It is: ___ a frog in the pond. -> answer: There is

problems: usual error says 'spelling by sound' but the wrong form heavyer is a y-to-i spelling slip, not a sound spelling

fix.usual_error: spelling slips in the -er form (heavyer, hapier, biger), or no than

problems: rule is about spelling only; a learner following it would not fix the wife/woman error shown in right/wrong and real confusion

fix.rule: Family words name people in the family: a man's wife, a woman's husband, mother, brother, sister.

problems: usual error calls windi 'missing vowels'; it is a wrong y ending

fix.usual_error: the noun instead of the describing word (It is rain), or a wrong ending (windi)
